cf_1037_b.raw_spec: Given odd n, target s and n positive integers, change individual values by unit increments/decrements to make the median exactly s; minimize the operation count.
cf_1037_b.l3_spec:
Given odd n, target s and n positive integers, change individual values by unit increments/decrements to make the median exactly s; minimize the operation count.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Require the median to be AT MOST s instead of exactly s.
cf_1037_b.l3_change: Require the median to be AT MOST s instead of exactly s.
cf_1037_b.proof_sketch: Sorting exposes which elements must cross s. An optimum never changes a value except directly to s: moving partway does not change its side of the threshold and moving farther adds cost. The oracle enumerates every unchanged/clipped choice and checks the median. The upper-bound variant only lowers values needed to ensure at least n//2+1 values<=s.

cf_1269_b.l3_spec:
Find the smallest nonnegative offset x making multiset {(a_i+x) mod m} equal multiset B. A solution is guaranteed. The smallest solution is equivalently the smallest valid representative in 0<=x<m.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Return the LARGEST valid normalized residue representative x in [0,m), instead of the smallest. The finite normalized domain is explicit; no unbounded maximum is claimed.
cf_1269_b.l3_change: Return the LARGEST valid normalized residue representative x in [0,m), instead of the smallest. The finite normalized domain is explicit; no unbounded maximum is claimed.
cf_1269_b.proof_sketch: A valid shift must send a[0] to some element of B, leaving at most n candidates. The optimized program checks candidates by sorted multisets; the oracle exhausts all residues and matches occurrences directly using used flags.

cf_1466_c.independent_oracle: Different construction: exhaustive search, direct simulation, or literal pair/window enumeration.
cf_1466_c.raw_spec: Minimize character replacements needed so a lowercase string has no palindromic substring longer than1.
cf_1466_c.l3_spec:
Minimize character replacements needed so a lowercase string has no palindromic substring longer than1.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Forbid only palindromic substrings of length EXACTLY2; longer palindromes are allowed.
cf_1466_c.l3_change: Forbid only palindromic substrings of length EXACTLY2; longer palindromes are allowed.
cf_1466_c.proof_sketch: Every palindrome of length>=2 contains a central palindrome of length2 or3. Thus raw conflicts are equal original letters distance1 or2; L3 keeps only distance1. Greedily replacing the right endpoint of the first unresolved conflict is optimal for this ordered conflict structure. The oracle independently enumerates replacement-position subsets and tests every original conflict edge; changed positions can always be assigned among26 letters avoiding their at most4 neighbors.

cf_1490_d.l3_spec:
Recursively make the maximum element of each permutation interval its binary-tree root. Output each original element position depth, with root depth0.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Use the MINIMUM element as each interval root instead of the maximum.
cf_1490_d.l3_change: Use the MINIMUM element as each interval root instead of the maximum.
cf_1490_d.proof_sketch: The monotone stack builds the unique Cartesian tree satisfying the inorder/permutation relation and heap ordering. A separate iterative traversal computes depths. The oracle literally scans each active interval to find its extremum, then processes the two subintervals; explicit stacks avoid recursion overflow.

cf_814_c.l3_spec:
For each pair(m,c), find the longest substring containing at most m characters different from c; this equals the longest all-c substring obtainable after at most m repaintings.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Change the selected-substring condition to EXACTLY m characters different from c. Only those mismatching characters are repainted to c. Output0 if no such substring exists.
cf_814_c.l3_change: Change the selected-substring condition to EXACTLY m characters different from c. Only those mismatching characters are repainted to c. Output0 if no such substring exists.

atcoder_abc120_c.independent_oracle: Different construction: exhaustive search, direct simulation, or literal pair/window enumeration.
atcoder_abc120_c.raw_spec: Repeatedly remove an adjacent pair of different binary colors; output the maximum removable cube count.
atcoder_abc120_c.l3_spec:
Repeatedly remove an adjacent pair of different binary colors; output the maximum removable cube count.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Only adjacent pairs of the SAME color may be removed.
atcoder_abc120_c.l3_change: Only adjacent pairs of the SAME color may be removed.
atcoder_abc120_c.proof_sketch: Raw cancels one zero and one one each time and reaches2*min(count0,count1). Under equal-color cancellation, aa->empty is a confluent terminating rewrite system (the only overlap aaa reduces to a either way), so a stack gives the unique irreducible residue. The oracle repeatedly searches from the beginning and erases the leftmost legal pair literally.

cf_1003_d.independent_oracle: Different construction: exhaustive search, direct simulation, or literal pair/window enumeration.
cf_1003_d.raw_spec: For each independent positive target, find the minimum number of available power-of-two coins summing exactly to it, or-1. Each input occurrence is usable at most once.
cf_1003_d.l3_spec:
For each independent positive target, find the minimum number of available power-of-two coins summing exactly to it, or-1. Each input occurrence is usable at most once.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Every denomination present in the input is available in UNLIMITED quantity; absent denominations remain unavailable.
cf_1003_d.l3_change: Every denomination present in the input is available in UNLIMITED quantity; absent denominations remain unavailable.
cf_1003_d.proof_sketch: For powers of two, exchanging two coins of a smaller size for one available double-size coin never increases the count. Descending greedy therefore minimizes coin count for both bounded and unlimited supply. Raw oracle enumerates every subset; L3 oracle solves minimum-coin shortest paths on integer target sums by dynamic programming.

cf_1110_e.l3_change: Allow AT MOST ONE synchronization operation instead of an arbitrary number.

cf_1110_e.proof_sketch: A synchronization swaps two adjacent first differences while keeping endpoints. Adjacent swaps generate all permutations, so equal endpoint and difference multiset is necessary and sufficient. The independent raw oracle enumerates all difference permutations and reconstructs charges. L3 can differ at only one internal coordinate; its oracle literally tries every possible operation.

cf_1344_a.raw_spec: For every integer room k move its guest to k+a_(k mod n); decide whether every room receives exactly one guest.
cf_1344_a.l3_spec:
For every integer room k move its guest to k+a_(k mod n); decide whether every room receives exactly one guest.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Move each guest to k-a_(k mod n) instead of k+a_(k mod n).
cf_1344_a.l3_change: Move each guest to k-a_(k mod n) instead of k+a_(k mod n).
cf_1344_a.proof_sketch: Every residue class maps bijectively to one destination residue class, so the infinite map is bijective exactly when the n destination residues are distinct.
